item.title: How Christians Can Recognize and Resist Theological Drift
item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word Q&A, Dave Jenkins explains how theological drift begins, what warning signs to watch for, and how Scripture calls believers to remain anchored in God's Word.

item.title: The Voice of the Lord: Worshiping the Sovereign King (Psalm 29)
item.description: Psalm 29 reveals the majesty and authority of God’s voice over creation. Learn how the Lord who thunders in power strengthens His people and blesses them with peace.

item.title: Created by God: A Biblical Response to Gender and Identity Confusion
item.description: The question of gender and identity is one of the most pressing discipleship issues facing the church today. In this episode of Equipping You in Grace, Dave Jenkins explains what the Bible teaches about gender, the image of God, and the significance of the human body.

item.title: Train for Godliness: Why Discipline Forms Resolute Christian Men
item.description: In this episode of Warriors of Grace, Dave Jenkins explains why Christian men must train for godliness. Drawing from 1 Timothy 4:7–8 and 1 Corinthians 9:24–27, this episode shows how discipline, structure, and intentional habits help form resolute men who faithfully follow Christ.

item.title: Psalm 30: God Turns Mourning Into Dancing
item.description: In this episode of Reading the Bible Daily with Dave, Dave Jenkins walks through Psalm 30—a psalm of thanksgiving that moves from distress to deliverance, from mourning to dancing, and from night to morning. David reminds believers that God's anger is momentary but His favor lasts a lifetime, and that weeping may tarry for the night but joy comes in the morning. Psalm 30 ultimately points us to Jesus Christ, whose resurrection secures lasting joy for His people.

item.description: In this episode of Contending for the Word, Dave Jenkins examines the Government Mountain of the Seven Mountain Mandate and compares its vision of cultural influence with the mission Christ gave His Church.
